question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        t.calendar_quarter_desc,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_quarter_sales
    PIVOT(SUM(total_sales) FOR calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')) AS p
    WHERE p['2019-04'] > 0
      AND 1.0 * (p['2020-04'] - p['2019-04']) / p['2019-04'] >= 0.20
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_quarter_desc,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
product_total AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        SUM(total_sales) as overall_sales,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_sales) DESC) as quintile
    FROM product_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM product_total
    WHERE quintile = 1
),
products_with_both_quarters AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM product_sales
    WHERE prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
    GROUP BY prod_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT calendar_quarter_desc) = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count
FROM products_with_both_quarters
